selection_rule: The same indices for every seed; specified before completed fitting banks or audit outcomes. No effect-based sample selection.
reconstruction: Recreate zero-effect local adapters and complete SGD state from original frozen models; advance every preceding selected block on its recorded seed/schedule, including zero-action gradient work. Reexecute all four branches at both selected boundaries.
media_readback: For each replayed branch, deliver and read back the first two cases in every one of the four conditions as real PNG and UTF8 files; verify bytes, then rescore alongside the full panel. These are development verification artifacts, not new task evaluation.
limitations: A deterministic execution/serialization check on the same fixed training value panel and three original models; not a new scientific replication, new labels, new writers or all-snapshot replay. Whole-bank non-replay arithmetic and identity checks are separate.
